en: A black‑and‑white image with a white printed border, showing a large villa or small mansion with steep, multi‑gabled roofs and dormer windows, partly hidden behind tall trees and dense foliage. The house has a central tower‑like roof section and balconies, in a style reminiscent of Central European or Germanic country houses from the early 20th century. The scene is framed by overhanging branches, giving it a picturesque, rural‑estate feeling. The edges of the image show wear and light damage typical of old photographic postcards.
